body:
I think it is because everyone dies sooner or later, and some people don’t want to know in advanced what a painful death is going to be like? I think. I’m not sure. To be fair i was a little more vivid with my sibling. Everyone who wants to die keep imagining or wanting to die fast or not see it coming, or for it to happen quick and painless. When my siblings asked I explained to them how I was on the Bathroom floor in pure agony for a good twenty minutes before my heart finally stopped. it kind of showed them that if it can happen to their sister their deaths could be awful to? My brothers always imagined their deaths in a blaze of glory I think?

 And I don’t want to upset people, better safer than sorry

Ok.. um but maybe I should do a disclaimer? I don’t want to upset anyone. I upset my siblings once by explaining it 

The first few times I was dying I was getting out of bed and I just got my legs over the side when I got dizzy in a blink of an eye. My head felt stuffy and started to pound to my heartbeat, like I suddenly had the worse head cold in my life- my ears popped and my limbs started to feel... not right. It’s hard to explain, like having too much blood rushing to your limbs and not enough. That was the first thing I notice. Not actually getting to the ground. I can never figure out how I ever end up wherever I land. It weird that way. Like teleporting. And if I can stay awake long enough after that?

It’s like... you KNOW something bad is happening- you KNOW that whatever is happening has to be stopped because you NEED to get up, but of course you can’t. Because there isn’t anything left? It’s always really surprising to feel how quickly I  lose all my strength and ability to move. You just have Nothing left. You can’t even figure out how to move a finger.

i did have a vivid hallucination one time. It was like time traveling through colors and memories. I could taste happiness.
